# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 6b. the C4-CGU block (2026-10-01)
# Block C4-CGU (rows9a.extra.json, generated by tools/mkextra9a.py): the tip's default row C4-JD on TWO binaries, `tip` (the existing exe, the
# parity profile = fat LTO + 16 codegen units) and `tipcgu1` (the same 50e31f1a export rebuilt with CARGO_PROFILE_PARITY_CODEGEN_UNITS=1). The two
# report the SAME config receipt and, by construction, the SAME pose, so no record-level validator can tell one from the other: the sha256 pin is
# the ONLY guard against one exe running under the other's label. The cases below prove that the pin fires, that the record validators do NOT
# (the honest negative control), that the A/B really compares two different images, and that the pose gate is byte-exact for both.
import hashlib  # noqa: E402

have_cgu = 'C4-JDcgu' in R.ROWS and 'tipcgu1' in R.BINS and 'C4-CGU' in [b['name'] for b in R.BLOCKS]
case('the C4-CGU overlay is merged (row C4-JDcgu, binary tipcgu1, block C4-CGU): without it every C4-CGU case would be vacuous',
     [] if have_cgu else ['rows9a.extra.json did not merge the C4-CGU block'], False)
CG_WS = (1, 2, 4, 8, 16)
CG_TMP = os.path.join(GATE, 'selftest_tmp', 'cgu9a')
shutil.rmtree(CG_TMP, ignore_errors=True)
os.makedirs(CG_TMP)


def cg_adjacent(cells):
    """[] when, at every W, the two binaries of the row occupy two CONSECUTIVE positions of the flat cell list."""
    bad = []
    for w in CG_WS:
        idx = sorted(i for i, c in enumerate(cells) if c[2] == w)
        if len(idx) != 2 or idx[1] - idx[0] != 1 or {cells[i][1] for i in idx} != {'tip', 'tipcgu1'}:
            bad.append(f'W{w}: positions {idx}')
    return bad


def cg_pose_bad(root, keys=('tip', 'tipcgu1')):
    """The keys/Ws whose recorded pose.bin is not the JT500 fixture BYTE FOR BYTE (a missing file is a failure)."""
    ref = open(os.path.join(GATE, 'fixtures', 'JT500.pose'), 'rb').read()
    bad = []
    for k in keys:
        for w in CG_WS:
            pth = os.path.join(root, f'C4-JDcgu_{k}_W{w}', 'pose.bin')
            if not os.path.exists(pth) or open(pth, 'rb').read() != ref:
                bad.append(f'{k} W{w}')
    return bad


if have_cgu:
    cb = next(b for b in R.BLOCKS if b['name'] == 'C4-CGU')
    crow, jdrow = R.ROWS['C4-JDcgu'], R.ROWS['C4-JD']
    case('C4-CGU: priority 0.5 (before every other block: it runs FIRST on --resume), K 9 = 3 passes x 3 rounds',
         [] if (cb['priority'], R.block_passes(cb), R.block_rounds(cb)) == (0.5, 3, 3) and [b['name'] for b in R.BLOCKS][0] == 'C4-CGU'
         and all(b['priority'] > 0.5 for b in R.BLOCKS if b['name'] != 'C4-CGU') else [str({k: cb.get(k) for k in ('priority', 'passes', 'rounds')})], False)
    case("C4-JDcgu is C4-JD's row on two binaries: the same args (the tip default = Tree, --sleeping off), workers, steps, window, armed, pose_ref, broadphase, TreeDiag expectation",
         [k for k in ('args', 'workers', 'steps', 'window', 'armed', 'pose_ref', 'broadphase', 'tree_diag_expect', 'bp_kernel', 'kind') if crow.get(k) != jdrow.get(k)], False)
    case("C4-JDcgu: binaries [tip, tipcgu1], pose_ref JT500, no --broadphase flag (the tip's DEFAULT), --sleeping off, W 1/2/4/8/16, 500 steps, window [0,500]",
         [] if (crow['binaries'] == ['tip', 'tipcgu1'] and crow['pose_ref'] == 'JT500' and '--broadphase' not in crow['args'] and crow['args'][-2:] == ['--sleeping', 'off']
                and crow['workers'] == [1, 2, 4, 8, 16] and crow['steps'] == 500 and crow['window'] == [0, 500]) else [str(crow)[:200]], False)
    case("C4-JDcgu metric windows: [100,500) and [0,500) (the orchestrator's spelling; C4-JD keeps its own [0,100) and [100,500))",
         [] if crow['metric_windows'] == [[100, 500], [0, 500]] and jdrow['metric_windows'] == [[0, 100], [100, 500]] else [str((crow['metric_windows'], jdrow['metric_windows']))], False)
    case('the overlay did not touch C4-JD (still C4-AB, still the single binary tip): C4-CGU is an ADDITION, not a replacement',
         [] if jdrow['binaries'] == ['tip'] and jdrow['blocks'] == ['C4-AB'] else [str((jdrow['binaries'], jdrow['blocks']))], False)
    case('C4-CGU holds exactly one row, C4-JDcgu', [] if [r for r, row in R.ROWS.items() if 'C4-CGU' in row['blocks']] == ['C4-JDcgu'] else ['other rows'], False)
    cg_cells = R.cell_order('C4-CGU')
    case('C4-CGU has 10 cells: tip / tipcgu1 x W 1/2/4/8/16',
         [] if len(cg_cells) == 10 and set(cg_cells) == {('C4-JDcgu', k, w) for k in ('tip', 'tipcgu1') for w in CG_WS} else [f'{len(cg_cells)} cells'], False)
    for p in range(3):
        case(f'C4-CGU pass {p}: tip and tipcgu1 are adjacent at every W (the order of each pass: p0 reversed, p1 forward, p2 reversed)',
             cg_adjacent(R.pass_order(cg_cells, p, cb)), False)
    case('C4-CGU pass order: p0 reversed, p1 forward, p2 reversed',
         [] if [R.pass_order(cg_cells, p, cb) for p in range(3)] == [cg_cells[::-1], cg_cells, cg_cells[::-1]] else ['wrong'], False)
    cg_moved = [c for c in cg_cells if c != ('C4-JDcgu', 'tip', 8)] + [('C4-JDcgu', 'tip', 8)]
    case('adjacency check on a permuted order (the W8 tip cell moved to the end)', cg_adjacent(cg_moved), True)
    case('C4-CGU: one untimed warm-up PER EXE per pass (C4-JDcgu tip W8, C4-JDcgu tipcgu1 W8)',
         [] if R.warmups_of(cb) == [('C4-JDcgu', 'tip', 8), ('C4-JDcgu', 'tipcgu1', 8)] else [str(R.warmups_of(cb))], False)
    case('C4-CGU: block note and row note carry the pre-registered claim verbatim (written before any timed process)',
         [w for w, t in (('block', cb.get('note', '')), ('row', crow.get('note', '')))
          if 'cgu1 claimed faster than cgu16 at W8 AND not claimed slower at any W' not in t or 'PRE-REGISTERED 2026-10-01' not in t
          or 'the shipped/parity profile moves to cgu 1' not in t], False)
    case('C4-CGU: every cell has an untimed gate estimate (none falls back to the default)',
         [f'{r}#{k}@W{w}' for r, k, w in cg_cells if f'{r}#{k}@W{w}' not in R.EST], False)
    case('the C4-CGU block is priced: block_estimate counts all 10 cells, K 9, 90 timed processes',
         [] if (R.block_estimate(cb)['cells'], R.block_estimate(cb)['k'], R.block_estimate(cb)['processes']) == (10, 9, 90) else [str(R.block_estimate(cb))], False)
    case('rerun_allowance of C4-CGU: the floor lets a single slot reach the full wave depth', [] if R.rerun_capacity(cb, 1.25) >= R.RERUN_MAX_WAVES else [str(R.rerun_capacity(cb, 1.25))], False)

    # ---- the binary: its pin, its distinct identity, the sha256 pin as the ONLY guard
    tb, cgb = R.BINS['tip'], R.BINS['tipcgu1']
    cg_file_sha = hashlib.sha256(open(cgb['path'], 'rb').read()).hexdigest()
    case('tipcgu1: sha256_pin == bin/SHA256SUMS == the file on disk; distinct from the tip exe (sha256 and path)',
         [] if (cgb.get('sha256_pin') == R.SUMS.get(cgb['exe']) == cg_file_sha and cgb['sha256_pin'] != tb['sha256_pin'] and cgb['path'] != tb['path']) else ['pin / sums / file disagree'], False)
    case("tipcgu1 carries the tip's config receipt expectation (tree_brute_max_rows 128, Manual) and S4 on: the same commit, one build flag apart",
         [] if (cgb.get('expect_config') == tb.get('expect_config') == {'tree_brute_max_rows': 128, 'broadphase_select': 'Manual'} and cgb.get('s4') == tb.get('s4') == 'on'
                and cgb['commit'].startswith(tb['commit'])) else [str((cgb.get('expect_config'), cgb.get('s4')))], False)
    case("the tipcgu1 exe name is not in VOID_NAMES (a copy of the window's own exe cannot void its own window)",
         [] if os.path.basename(cgb['path']).lower() not in R.VOID_NAMES else ['name collides'], False)
    cg_secs = {}
    sys.path.insert(0, HERE)
    import pe_diff9a  # noqa: E402
    for k, e in (('tip', tb), ('tipcgu1', cgb)):
        data, secs = pe_diff9a.sections(e['path'])
        cg_secs[k] = {n: hashlib.sha256(data[ptr:ptr + rs]).hexdigest() for n, vs, rs, ptr in secs}
    case('the A/B compares two DIFFERENT images: .text of tip and tipcgu1 differ (an identical .text would make the block compare an exe with itself)',
         [] if cg_secs['tip']['.text'] != cg_secs['tipcgu1']['.text'] else ['same .text'], False)
    case('verify_binaries as written with tipcgu1 in the set (SHA256SUMS + sha256_pin)', R.verify_binaries(), False)
    cg_saved = {k: dict(R.BINS[k]) for k in ('tip', 'tipcgu1')}
    for k, o2 in (('tip', 'tipcgu1'), ('tipcgu1', 'tip')):
        R.BINS[k].update({'exe': cg_saved[o2]['exe'], 'path': cg_saved[o2]['path'], 'sha256': R.SUMS.get(cg_saved[o2]['exe'])})
    case('verify_binaries with the tip / tipcgu1 exes swapped, pins kept: the cgu1 exe relabelled as cgu16 (and back) is RED',
         only_for(R.verify_binaries(), 'a key/exe swap'), True)
    for k in ('tip', 'tipcgu1'):
        R.BINS[k].pop('sha256_pin', None)
    case('the same swap WITHOUT the pins is green: SHA256SUMS is keyed by path and cannot see it, the sha256 pin is load-bearing',
         R.verify_binaries(), False)
    for k in ('tip', 'tipcgu1'):
        R.BINS[k].clear()
        R.BINS[k].update(cg_saved[k])
    R.BINS['tip'].update({'exe': cg_saved['tipcgu1']['exe'], 'path': cg_saved['tipcgu1']['path']})          # ONE key re-pointed, sha256 fields left
    case('the key `tip` re-pointed at the cgu1 exe (its own sha256 and pin left as they were): RED', R.verify_binaries(), True)
    R.BINS['tip'].clear()
    R.BINS['tip'].update(cg_saved['tip'])
    R.BINS['tipcgu1'].update({'exe': cg_saved['tip']['exe'], 'path': cg_saved['tip']['path']})
    case('the key `tipcgu1` re-pointed at the cgu16 exe: RED', R.verify_binaries(), True)
    R.BINS['tipcgu1'].clear()
    R.BINS['tipcgu1'].update(cg_saved['tipcgu1'])
    case('verify_binaries restored', R.verify_binaries(), False)

    # ---- the record validators on the REAL gate cells (gate9a.py rows C4-JDcgu): green as recorded; what they can and cannot see
    if all(os.path.exists(cell_dir('C4-JDcgu', k, w)) for k in ('tip', 'tipcgu1') for w in CG_WS):
        for k in ('tip', 'tipcgu1'):
            for w in CG_WS:
                case(f'C4-JDcgu {k} W{w} as recorded by the gate (pose = JT500, expect_pose match, void 0, Tree, config receipt, TreeDiag)', judged('C4-JDcgu', k, w), False)
        case('a C4-JDcgu tipcgu1 record relabelled `tip` is GREEN at the record level: same config receipt, same pose - only the sha256 pin can see a swap (the cases above)',
             judged('C4-JDcgu', 'tipcgu1', 8, binary='tip'), False)
        case('a C4-JDcgu tipcgu1 record relabelled `parent` (an AllPairs-default exe under the cgu1 label) is red: the config receipt',
             only_for(judged('C4-JDcgu', 'tipcgu1', 8, binary='parent'), 'tree_brute_max_rows'), True)
        case('tipcgu1 record with the pose hash mutated', only_for(judged('C4-JDcgu', 'tipcgu1', 8, edit=lambda s: {**s, 'pose_hash': '0x0'}), 'pose'), True)
        case('tipcgu1 record with expect_pose "mismatch"', only_for(judged('C4-JDcgu', 'tipcgu1', 8, edit=lambda s: {**s, 'expect_pose': 'mismatch'}), 'expect_pose'), True)
        case('tipcgu1 record with tree_brute_max_rows 144 in its config receipt',
             only_for(judged('C4-JDcgu', 'tipcgu1', 8, edit=lambda s: {**s, 'config': {**s['config'], 'tree_brute_max_rows': 144}}), 'tree_brute_max_rows'), True)
        case('the W8 tipcgu1 record judged at W4 (workers)', only_for(R.validate_runner(runner_rec('C4-JDcgu', 'tipcgu1', 8), R.ROWS['C4-JDcgu'], 4), 'workers'), True)
        case('tipcgu1 record with TreeDiag static_rebuilds 2',
             only_for(judged('C4-JDcgu', 'tipcgu1', 8, edit=lambda s: {**s, 'broadphase_tree': {**s['broadphase_tree'], 'static_rebuilds': 2}}), 'TreeDiag'), True)
        # the pose gate is BYTE-exact for both exes at every W, and it can go red
        case('cgu must not change a single pose byte: every gate cell of BOTH exes (W 1/2/4/8/16) wrote pose.bin == JT500.pose byte for byte',
             cg_pose_bad(os.path.join(GATE, 'cells')), False)
        ref_bytes = open(os.path.join(GATE, 'fixtures', 'JT500.pose'), 'rb').read()
        tdir = os.path.join(CG_TMP, 'cells')
        for k in ('tip', 'tipcgu1'):
            for w in CG_WS:
                shutil.copytree(cell_dir('C4-JDcgu', k, w), os.path.join(tdir, f'C4-JDcgu_{k}_W{w}'))
        flipped = bytearray(ref_bytes)
        flipped[52 * 617 % len(flipped)] ^= 0x01
        open(os.path.join(tdir, 'C4-JDcgu_tipcgu1_W8', 'pose.bin'), 'wb').write(bytes(flipped))
        case('the pose byte check on a copy of the cells with ONE bit flipped in tipcgu1 W8 names exactly that cell', [] if cg_pose_bad(tdir) == ['tipcgu1 W8'] else [str(cg_pose_bad(tdir))], True)
        os.remove(os.path.join(tdir, 'C4-JDcgu_tip_W2', 'pose.bin'))
        case('the pose byte check with a missing pose.bin (tip W2) is red, never a pass', [] if 'tip W2' in cg_pose_bad(tdir) else ['not flagged'], True)
    else:
        print('SKIP C4-CGU record cases: gate/cells/C4-JDcgu_* has not run (python -B tools/gate9a.py rows C4-JDcgu)')

    # ---- the build receipts: -C codegen-units=1 reached every crate of the cgu1 build and none of the control's (vacuity guard of the whole block)
    def cg_units(log):
        lines = [l for l in open(os.path.join(W9, 'logs', log), encoding='utf-8', errors='replace') if 'Running' in l and '--crate-name' in l and 'codegen-units=' in l]
        return sorted({l.split('codegen-units=')[1].split()[0] for l in lines}), len(lines)
    if os.path.exists(os.path.join(W9, 'logs', 'build_tipcgu1.log')) and os.path.exists(os.path.join(W9, 'logs', 'build_tipctl.log')):
        u1, n1 = cg_units('build_tipcgu1.log')
        case('build receipt: every rustc line of the cgu1 build that names codegen-units names 1 (and there are many: the override reached the crates)',
             [] if u1 == ['1'] and n1 > 50 else [f'{u1} x {n1}'], False)
        u0, n0 = cg_units('build_tipctl.log')
        case("build receipt: the control build (the tree's own parity profile, override unset) passes no -C codegen-units at all (the profile default 16 applies)",
             [] if n0 == 0 else [f'{u0} x {n0}'], False)
        case('build receipt: both builds used --locked on the same Cargo.lock (sha256 equal before and after each)',
             [] if len({open(os.path.join(W9, 'logs', f)).read().split()[0] for f in ('build_tipcgu1.log.lock_before', 'build_tipcgu1.log.lock_after', 'build_tipctl.log.lock_before', 'build_tipctl.log.lock_after')}) == 1
             else ['lock differs'], False)
    else:
        print('SKIP C4-CGU build receipt cases: logs/build_tipcgu1.log / build_tipctl.log absent')
